issues.desc: The abbreviation "H2" is used repeatedly (index.json title/description/keywords, background.md ## Key Insights, checklist.json CHK-002 title+context) but is never expanded within the story artifacts themselves. Only the external plan doc (docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md section 9 table) defines H2 as the "Tamper fail-closed" hypothesis. A fresh reader with only background.md/index.json/checklist.json open can infer the operational meaning (fingerprint-match assertion on tamper classes) from context, but never learns literally what H2 stands for or that there is a companion H1/H3/H4 hypothesis set.

index.json has no riskSignals field at all (not even an empty array), unlike a typical fully-populated index.json. Priority is medium so the Dimension-3 hard keyword-match rule does not apply, but the field's total absence is a minor mechanical completeness gap.
